in_marathi.name: Shivapriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beloved of Lord Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivapriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shivapriya is a unisex name that means 'beloved of Lord Shiva' in Sanskrit. It is often given to children born under the influence of Lord Shiva.
